name: Nancy
source:
Member of Money Dragon.
One of the "Money Dragons," a beautiful woman with blond hair and blue eyes. Despite her young appearance, she is a prodigy who has mastered all kinds of martial arts and assassination techniques.

[Translated from in-game profile]

(Character is exclusive to non-canon "Brave of Death" route)
